effect_description_eng: [On Play] Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck. Add 1 2-color green card and 1 Tamer card with [Henry Wong] in its name among them to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] When one of your Digimon is suspended by an ＜Alliance＞ effect, you may digivolve this Digimon into a 2-color green card in your hand for its digivolution cost. When this Digimon would digivolve with this effect, reduce the digivolution cost by 2.
